minutes_text:
CITY OF BEVERLY HILLS
  455 N. Rexford Drive
  2nd Floor Council Chamber
  Beverly Hills, CA 90210

  Strategic Planning/Southeast Task Force Committee Meeting

  HIGHLIGHTS

  Monday, May 13, 2019
  5:00 PM
MEETING CALLED TO ORDER
Date / Time  May 13, 2019/ 5:00pm

IN ATTENDANCE:  Councilmember Julian Gold, City Manager Mahdi Aluzri, Director of
  Community Development Susan Healy Keene, Assistant Director of
  Community Development Ryan Gohlich, Assistant Planner
  Timothea Tway, Policy and Management Analyst Cindy Owens,
  John Luca, Julian Javor, Victoria Talbot, Linda Brown, Ed Brown,
  Pam Kurtz, Ilene Rotenberg, Sam Rotenberg, Sly Schaffel, Cory
  Schaffel, Sharon Ignarro, Susan Mishler, Sharon Persovski, Mark
  Eliot.

  1.  Public Comment
   None.

  2. Welcome and Introduction
   Staff members welcomed the group and meeting attendees introduced
  themselves.

  3. Summary of Background Information on the Southeast Area of Beverly Hills
   Director of Community Development Susan Healy Keene gave
  background information on the Southeast Task Force Committee, focusing
  on commercial issues and areas. The goal of the committee is to produce
  actions that will be recommended to the City Council and may consist of
  changes to the municipal code.
   Future Strategic Planning Committee/Southeast Task Force Area
  Committee meetings will be held as open forum (town hall) style meetings.

  4. Discussion of Goals and Anticipated Next Steps
   Topics to be discussed include commercial uses; urban design; mobility;
  pedestrian amenities; and art, history and culture. Decision points will be
  highlighted and discussed. Committee members are encouraged to think
  about the subway station, La Cienega Park, desires of community
  members, changing technology, and changing retail.
   The goals of the group are to discuss a variety of ideas, provide an
  opportunity for everyone to participate, and produce action items that will
  be implemented to produce positive change in the Southeast Area.
 5. Activity and Feedback
   Committee members provided feedback and discussed their individual
  concerns and suggestions.
   Next meeting date will be June 10, 2019.

6. Adjourn
  Date / Time  May 13, 2019/ 5:58pm
